items.title: U.S. Futures Rise Steady Ahead of Jobs Report
items.summary: The Labor Department will release its latest employment report today, and economists are expecting it to show that the U.S. economy added 83,000 jobs in July.  The unemployment rate is expected to hold steady at 4.2%.  U.S. stock futures are ticking higher ahead of the report’s release at 8:30 a.m. ET.
